cast.name: Emma Brooks
cast.personality: Curious, enthusiastic, a little anxious about mistakes. Asks the questions beginners really ask and celebrates small wins.
cast.appearance: Fair skin with light freckles, sandy-blonde ponytail with side-swept bangs, green eyes, warm open smile.
cast.outfit: Mint-green hoodie, light jeans, white sneakers, small backpack with a travel patch.

cast.name: Mateo Ruiz
cast.personality: Patient, funny, warm. Corrects Emma with a joke, never with embarrassment. Loves food and explains why people really say things.
cast.appearance: Warm brown skin, short dark wavy hair, light stubble, kind dark-brown eyes, relaxed grin.
cast.outfit: Terracotta button shirt with rolled sleeves over a cream tee, dark chinos, brown boots.

cast.name: Camila 'Cami' Torres
cast.personality: Energetic, dramatic, chaotic in a lovable way. Creates funny misunderstandings, exaggerates reactions, always hungry.
cast.appearance: Tan skin, long dark hair in two high space buns with loose curls, bold red lipstick, big gold hoop earrings, expressive eyebrows.
cast.outfit: Magenta bomber jacket with a sunflower pin, yellow top, black high-waist pants, yellow sneakers.

cast.name: Santiago 'Santi' Herrera
cast.personality: Calm, curious, always filming. Introduces travel situations, local culture and natural expressions. Dry humor.
cast.appearance: Medium-brown skin, tall and lean, curly dark hair with round sunglasses pushed up, short beard, small camera on a strap.
cast.outfit: Teal utility vest over a mustard tee, khaki shorts, hiking sandals.
